categories.main_business_segments: The company operates in four main business segments: (1) Deep cryogenic technology equipment manufacturing - designing and manufacturing LNG liquefaction devices, air separation equipment, and related cryogenic systems; (2) Traffic service equipment manufacturing - producing integrated energy stations, charging stations, and refueling stations; (3) Gas investment and operations - producing and selling industrial gases, specialty gases, and LNG; (4) Clean energy investment and operations - developing hydrogen energy projects and LNG energy services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in deep cryogenic technology for gas liquefaction and separation. Core technologies include natural gas liquefaction processes, liquid air separation equipment design and manufacturing, hydrogen liquefaction systems, helium extraction and purification, and electronic specialty gas separation. The company has design and manufacturing capabilities for LNG devices processing up to 10 million cubic meters daily, liquid air separation equipment with daily production capacity of 1,000 tons, and gas air separation equipment at 100,000 Nm³/h oxygen production level.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves customers in energy, chemical, metallurgical, semiconductor, medical, food, and transportation sectors. Primary markets include natural gas liquefaction projects, industrial gas supply for manufacturing, hydrogen fuel cell vehicle infrastructure, and transportation energy services. Key customer types include energy companies, chemical manufacturers, steel producers, and transportation infrastructure operators.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Chengdu, Sichuan Province. Major operating regions include Sichuan, Inner Mongolia, Xinjiang, and other provinces. The company has expanded internationally with projects in Indonesia, Nigeria, and other countries along the Belt and Road Initiative. Domestic revenue represents 92.34% of total revenue while international revenue accounts for 7.66%.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: upstream in equipment design and manufacturing for gas processing; midstream in gas production and liquefaction operations; and downstream in gas distribution and energy services. The company provides complete solutions from equipment manufacturing through project implementation to operational management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) advancing hydrogen energy technology development and commercialization as a core future direction; (2) expanding gas investment and operations through acquisitions and organic growth; (3) developing integrated energy station solutions combining oil, gas, electricity, and hydrogen; (4) enhancing deep cryogenic technology capabilities for large-scale applications; (5) pursuing international market expansion. R&D focuses on hydrogen liquefaction, large-scale air separation, and clean energy technologies.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through multiple channels: (1) equipment sales - designing and manufacturing cryogenic equipment and systems sold to customers; (2) engineering services - providing design, installation, and commissioning services; (3) gas operations - producing and selling industrial gases, specialty gases, and LNG; (4) energy services - operating LNG stations and integrated energy facilities. Revenue is recognized upon customer acceptance of equipment or delivery of products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China's deep cryogenic equipment manufacturing sector with over 20 years of industry experience. It competes with other cryogenic equipment manufacturers and gas companies. The company differentiates through advanced technology, comprehensive product portfolio, strong project execution capabilities, and integration with parent company Shudu Group's transportation infrastructure resources. The company holds leading market position in LNG and air separation equipment design and manufacturing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized equipment manufacturer with 2024 revenue of 861.5 million yuan, representing 28.9% growth from 2023 revenue of 668.4 million yuan. Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders was 72.4 million yuan in 2024, up 121.67% from 32.6 million yuan in 2023. Total assets reached 2.1 billion yuan at year-end 2024. The company demonstrates strong growth trajectory with expanding profitability and cash generation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's competitive advantages include: (1) advanced deep cryogenic technology with 20+ years of development and proven track record; (2) comprehensive product portfolio covering LNG, air separation, hydrogen, and specialty gas equipment; (3) large-scale manufacturing capabilities and project execution expertise; (4) integration with Shudu Group providing access to transportation infrastructure and energy resources; (5) focus on clean energy and hydrogen technology positioning for future market demands; (6) quality assurance through ISO certifications and special equipment manufacturing permits.
